title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**\# DevOps and Compliance Engineer – Roles \& Responsibilities**

**\#\# Role Overview**

A DevOps and Compliance Engineer (1–2 years experience) at Instape is responsible for bridging software development and IT operations by implementing automation, continuous integration and deployment, infrastructure management, and monitoring practices on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while helping uphold security, data\-protection, and regulatory\-compliance standards across the delivery lifecycle. Given Instape operates in the regulated digital\-lending / fintech space, the role also supports adherence to applicable financial\-services and data\-privacy requirements. It requires solid technical fundamentals, operational discipline, and the ability to collaborate effectively across development, security, and business teams to ensure reliable, secure, and compliant software delivery.

**\#\# Key Responsibilities**

**\#\#\# Project \& Stakeholder Management**

\- Understand customer requirements, business objectives, and project KPIs.  
\- Collaborate with development, operations, security, and business teams to ensure seamless delivery.  
\- Maintain effective communication with internal teams and support stakeholder updates.  
\- Participate in sprint planning, task estimation, and team coordination activities.  
\- Provide periodic status updates and progress reports.

**\#\#\# Infrastructure \& Environment Management**

\- Set up, configure, and maintain development, testing, staging, and production environments on GCP.  
\- Design and manage scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure using Cloud Run (serverless containers), with Cloud Functions and Compute Engine where appropriate.  
\- Administer Linux\-based environments and virtual machines.  
\- Manage GCP networking, including Serverless VPC Access and Network Security configurations.

**\#\#\# DevOps \& Automation**

\- Define and implement DevOps processes, standards, and best practices.  
\- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, Cloud Source Repositories, and Artifact Registry for automated integration, testing, container builds, and deployment.  
\- Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployments (Infrastructure as Code with Terraform).  
\- Continuously identify opportunities for process optimization and operational efficiency.

**\#\#\# Software Development \& Release Management**

\- Review, validate, and verify application code and deployment configurations.  
\- Support development teams in troubleshooting application and deployment issues.  
\- Manage release planning, deployment scheduling, and rollback strategies (including Cloud Run revisions and traffic splitting).  
\- Ensure adherence to development, testing, release, and support processes.

**\#\#\# Monitoring \& Incident Management**

\- Monitor application performance, system health, and infrastructure utilization using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.  
\- Manage incident response, root cause analysis, and problem resolution.  
\- Implement proactive monitoring and alerting mechanisms.  
\- Drive continuous improvement based on operational metrics and incident trends.

**\#\#\# Security \& Compliance**  
\- Implement and maintain security controls throughout the DevOps lifecycle using Secret Manager, Cloud KMS, and IAM.  
\- Support vulnerability assessment and image scanning via Container Analysis, and assist with risk management activities.  
\- Manage secure access using Identity\-Aware Proxy (IAP) and least\-privilege IAM policies.  
\- Support secure handling of sensitive and personally identifiable information (PII), including KYC and customer financial data, through encryption, access controls, and data\-retention practices.  
\- Maintain audit trails, access logs, consent records, and evidence to support internal and external audits, and assist in remediating findings from VAPT and audit exercises.  
\- Support incident reporting and breach\-notification processes in line with regulatory timelines (e.g., CERT\-In directives).  
\- Ensure compliance with organizational security policies, data\-localization requirements, and applicable industry and regulatory standards, and collaborate with security and compliance teams on secure development and deployment practices.

**\#\# Essential Skills \& Qualifications**

**\#\#\# Technical Skills**  
\- Working experience with Linux\-based infrastructure.  
\- Proficiency in scripting/programming such as Python (Bash and others a plus).  
\- Experience with databases such as Cloud Firestore, and relational databases like Cloud SQL / PostgreSQL / MySQL.  
\- Strong troubleshooting and debugging capabilities.

**\#\#\# DevOps Tools \& Technologies**  
\- Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tooling — Git, Cloud Build, Cloud Source Repositories, Artifact Registry (experience with Jenkins/GitHub Actions is a plus).  
\- Experience with containerization using Docker.  
\- Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.  
\- Exposure to event\-driven and workflow tooling — Pub/Sub, Eventarc, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Workflows — is a plus.

**\#\#\# Cloud Technologies (GCP)**  
\- Hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud\-based applications on Google Cloud Platform.  
\- Working knowledge of core GCP services: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Compute Engine, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry, Secret Manager, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging.

**\#\#\# Security \& Compliance**  
\- Understanding of cybersecurity principles, vulnerability management, and risk assessment.  
\- Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and secure deployment methodologies.  
\- Awareness of data\-protection and privacy principles, and secure handling of sensitive customer data.

**\#\#\# Soft Skills**  
\- Good communication and collaboration skills.  
\- Analytical thinking and problem\-solving capabilities.  
\- Ability to work in fast\-paced Agile and DevOps environments.

**\#\# Preferred Knowledge**  
\- Agile and Scrum methodologies.  
\- ITIL principles and incident management practices.  
\- Exposure to compliance and security frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing) is an added advantage.  
\- Awareness of data\-privacy regulations (India's DPDP Act; GDPR awareness a plus) and secure PII/KYC data handling.  
\- Familiarity with financial\-services / digital\-lending regulatory requirements (e.g., RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, KYC/AML norms, data\-localization requirements) is an added advantage.  
\- Understanding of CERT\-In incident\-reporting requirements.  
\- Firebase services (Authentication / Identity Toolkit, Remote Config, Cloud Messaging).  
\- Industry best practices for system reliability, scalability, and security.

\*\*Work Location:\*\* In person

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
At Accellor, a DevOps Engineer designs, builds, and maintains scalable cloud\-native infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation. They streamline software and data delivery by managing CI/CD pipelines, optimizing cloud costs, and ensuring robust security and observability.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**

* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Build and manage cloud foundation platforms using tools like Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
* **Pipeline Automation:** Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or similar platforms to automate deployments.
* **Cloud Operations \& Cost Optimization:** Configure cloud services (IAM, VPC, EC2, Kubernetes) and optimize resource usage for cost efficiency and scalability.
* **Security \& Compliance:** Enforce security best practices, including IAM policies, least privilege access, data encryption, and compliance monitoring.
* **Monitoring \& Support:** Develop robust observability, logging, and alerting frameworks using tools like Datadog, Prometheus, or CloudWatch.
* Implement security best practices and integrate vulnerability scanning for source code, containers, and infrastructure within CI/CD pipelines.
* Identify, assess, and remediate security vulnerabilities and configuration issues across cloud and application environments.
* Recommend and implement cloud resource organization, subscription structure, access controls, and governance standards.

Collaborate with development and architecture teams to design secure, scalable, and cost\-effective cloud solutions.  
* 

  

  

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of professional IT experience, with at least 5 years focused on cloud, data engineering, or DevOps.
* **Cloud Platforms:** Strong, demonstrable expertise in AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* **Scripting \& Languages:** Proficiency in programming languages like Python, Bash, or Go.
* **DevOps Tools:** Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Git/GitOps practices.
* **Database/Data Skills:** Familiarity with SQL and data lake/warehouse architectures, as EXL heavily integrates DevOps with AI\-driven analytics.

  

**Benefits** **Exciting Projects:** We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.


**Collaborative Environment:** You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centres.  

**Work\-Life Balance:** Accellor prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.  

**Professional Development:** Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training, Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.  

  

**Excellent Benefits:** We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Personal Accident Insurance, Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.

**Disclaimer: \-**


Accellor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic

title: Senior Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Cloud Data & Databricks

title: Lead/Senior SRE Engineer - Dynatrace
description:

We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are looking for an experienced **Lead/Senior SRE Engineer with strong Dynatrace expertise** to join our team.


In this role, you will drive the implementation of DevOps and SRE practices, shape the technology roadmap, and ensure the reliability, performance, and observability of our production systems. You will collaborate closely with application teams and product owners to foster a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities**

* Implement DevOps \& SRE practices across the organization

* Define, refine, and maintain SLIs and SLOs, plus MTTR, Lead time for change, Deployment Frequency, and Change Failure Rate metrics
* Design, build, and run monitoring, alerting, operability, and observability for applications using Dynatrace, Splunk, and Grafana

* Ensure application teams meet performance and availability SLAs
* Partner with product owners to manage error budget, prioritize the toil backlog, and validate outcomes against team, application, and incident metrics
* Join an on\-call rotation to respond to production events or outages
* Improve continuous integration \& continuous deployment via the CI/CD Pipeline
* Apply troubleshooting methods, incident management, and root cause analysis
* Promote and create automated processes wherever possible
* Implement cybersecurity measures through ongoing vulnerability assessment and risk management
* Prepare periodic progress reporting for management and the customer
* Collaborate with application teams to simplify adoption of the platform, and coordinate communication within the team and with customers
* Review the current system and produce plans for enhancements and improvements

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of general IT experience, including 5\+ years within DevOps or SRE teams
* Solid background in supporting production infrastructure
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD
* Deep understanding of observability (monitoring, logging, and tracing)
* Proven expertise in Dynatrace and Splunk
* Familiarity with a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Strong ability to operate high\-availability, fault\-tolerant, scalable, distributed software in production
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively, with strong organization, interpersonal skills, and experience building operational maturity
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, including strategic thinking and the ability to troubleshoot under pressure
* Adaptability to pick up new technologies quickly
* English proficiency at B2 (Upper\-Intermediate) or higher

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
